besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If you press this button, the machine stops.
postopek: zero conditional.

besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.
postopek: mixed conditional.

besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If she had studied, she would have passed.
postopek: third conditional.

besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
postopek: second conditional.

besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If you heat ice, it melts.
postopek: zero conditional.

postopek: second conditional.

besedilo: Kateri pogojnik je v povedi: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the train.
postopek: third conditional.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If you ___ (mix) red and white, you get pink.
postopek:
If you mix (mix) red and white, you get pink.

Zero conditional: if + present simple, present simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If it ___ (be) sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
postopek:
If it is (be) sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.

First conditional: if + present simple, will + glagol.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If I ___ (have) a dog, I would walk it every day.
postopek:
If I had (have) a dog, I would walk it every day.

Second conditional: if + past simple, would + glagol.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If I ___ (be) you, I would take the offer.
postopek:
If I were (be) you, I would take the offer.

If I were you – nasvet; »were« za vse osebe je bolj formalno.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If she ___ (know) the answer, she would have told us.
postopek:
If she had known (know) the answer, she would have told us.

Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: We ___ (miss) the bus if we don't hurry.
postopek:
We will miss (miss) the bus if we don't hurry.

First conditional – realna možnost v prihodnosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If he had trained harder, he ___ (win) the race.
postopek:
If he had trained harder, he would have won (win) the race.

Third conditional – neuresničena preteklost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If I won the lottery, I ___ (travel) around the world.
postopek:
If I won the lottery, I would travel (travel) around the world.

Second conditional – malo verjetna sedanjost/prihodnost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Unless you ___ (study), you will fail.
postopek:
Unless you study (study), you will fail.

Unless = if not; za njim ne uporabimo nikalnice.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If I had saved more money, I ___ (be) able to buy a car now.
postopek:
If I had saved more money, I would be (be) able to buy a car now.

Mixed conditional: preteklo dejanje s posledico v sedanjosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If she weren't so shy, she ___ (speak) to him at the party yesterday.
postopek:
If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken (speak) to him at the party yesterday.

Mixed conditional: trajna lastnost s posledico v preteklosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I wish I ___ (have) more free time.
postopek:
I wish I had (have) more free time.

Wish + past simple za želje o sedanjosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I wish I ___ (not say) that yesterday.
postopek:
I wish I hadn't said (not say) that yesterday.

Wish + past perfect za obžalovanje preteklosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: ___ you need help, call me.
postopek:
Should you need help, call me.

Inverzija: Should you need = If you need (formalno).

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: ___ I known, I would have come.
postopek:
Had I known, I would have come.

Inverzija v third conditional: Had I known = If I had known.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: You can borrow my car as long as you ___ (drive) carefully.
postopek:
You can borrow my car as long as you drive (drive) carefully.

As long as = pod pogojem, da; sledi present simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If the weather ___ (be) nicer, we would eat outside.
postopek:
If the weather were (be) nicer, we would eat outside.

Second conditional.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: What would you do if you ___ (find) a wallet in the street?
postopek:
What would you do if you found (find) a wallet in the street?

Second conditional – hipotetična situacija.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If you ___ (not water) plants, they die.
postopek:
If you don't water (not water) plants, they die.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: It's time we ___ (go) home.

It's time we went (go) home.

It's time + past simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I'd rather you ___ (not tell) anyone.
postopek:
I'd rather you didn't tell (not tell) anyone.

Would rather + oseba + past simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If they ___ (invite) me, I would have gone.
postopek:
If they had invited (invite) me, I would have gone.

Third conditional.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Provided that it ___ (not rain), the match will take place.

Provided that it doesn't rain (not rain), the match will take place.

Provided that kot if; present simple za prihodnost.

If I were (be) taller, I could play basketball.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Mount Everest is ___ (high) mountain in the world.

Mount Everest is the highest (high) mountain in the world.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: My brother is two years ___ (old) than me.
postopek:
My brother is two years older (old) than me.

Primernik + than; elder samo pred samostalnikom (my elder brother).

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: This exercise is ___ (easy) than the last one.
postopek:
This exercise is easier (easy) than the last one.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Today is ___ (hot) day of the year so far.
postopek:
Today is the hottest (hot) day of the year so far.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Flying is ___ (expensive) than taking the train.
postopek:
Flying is more expensive (expensive) than taking the train.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: This is ___ (bad) film I have ever seen.
postopek:
This is the worst (bad) film I have ever seen.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Her English is much ___ (good) than mine.

Her English is much better (good) than mine.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Could you speak a bit ___ (slowly), please?

Could you speak a bit more slowly (slowly), please?

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The new phone isn't as ___ (light) as the old one.

The new phone isn't as light (light) as the old one.

V zvezi as … as je pridevnik v osnovni obliki.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The ___ (much) you practise, the better you get.

The more (much) you practise, the better you get.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Prices are getting higher and ___ (high).

Prices are getting higher and higher (high).

Primernik + and + primernik = vedno bolj.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Ljubljana is ___ (far) from the sea than Koper.

Ljubljana is farther (far) from the sea than Koper.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: We need ___ (far) information before we decide.
postopek:
We need further (far) information before we decide.

further = dodaten; farther samo za razdaljo.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: There are ___ (few) cars in the town centre now than ten years ago.
postopek:
There are fewer (few) cars in the town centre now than ten years ago.

Števni samostalnik v množini: fewer; neštevni: less.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: This flat is twice as ___ (big) as ours.
postopek:
This flat is twice as big (big) as ours.

twice as + osnovna oblika + as.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She is ___ (talented) student in our class.
postopek:
She is the most talented (talented) student in our class.

Večzložni presežnik: the most + pridevnik; signal »in our class«.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He drove ___ (carefully) than his brother.
postopek:
He drove more carefully (carefully) than his brother.

Prislov na -ly: more carefully.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Of all the runners, Ana ran ___ (fast).
postopek:
Of all the runners, Ana ran the fastest (fast).

fast je pridevnik in prislov: fast – faster – the fastest.

Mount Everest is the highest (high) mountain in the world.

Dvozložni pridevnik na -y: y → i + -er.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Today is ___ (hot) day of the year so far.
postopek:
Today is the hottest (hot) day of the year so far.

Soglasnik–samoglasnik–soglasnik: podvojiš t; presežnik s the.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Flying is ___ (expensive) than taking the train.
postopek:
Flying is more expensive (expensive) than taking the train.

Večzložni pridevnik: more + pridevnik.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: This is ___ (bad) film I have ever seen.
postopek:
This is the worst (bad) film I have ever seen.

Nepravilni: bad – worse – the worst; signal »ever«.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Her English is much ___ (good) than mine.
postopek:
Her English is much better (good) than mine.

Nepravilni: good – better – best; much okrepi primernik.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Could you speak a bit ___ (slowly), please?
postopek:
Could you speak a bit more slowly (slowly), please?

Prislov na -ly: more + prislov.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The new phone isn't as ___ (light) as the old one.
postopek:
The new phone isn't as light (light) as the old one.

V zvezi as … as je pridevnik v osnovni obliki.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The ___ (much) you practise, the better you get.
postopek:
The more (much) you practise, the better you get.

The + primernik …, the + primernik = čim bolj …, tem bolj.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Prices are getting higher and ___ (high).
postopek:
Prices are getting higher and higher (high).

Primernik + and + primernik = vedno bolj.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Ljubljana is ___ (far) from the sea than Koper.
postopek:
Ljubljana is farther (far) from the sea than Koper.

far – farther/further; za razdaljo sta pravilna oba.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: We need ___ (far) information before we decide.
postopek:
We need further (far) information before we decide.

further = dodaten; farther samo za razdaljo.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: There are ___ (few) cars in the town centre now than ten years ago.
postopek:
There are fewer (few) cars in the town centre now than ten years ago.

Števni samostalnik v množini: fewer; neštevni: less.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: This flat is twice as ___ (big) as ours.
postopek:
This flat is twice as big (big) as ours.

twice as + osnovna oblika + as.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She is ___ (talented) student in our class.
postopek:
She is the most talented (talented) student in our class.

Večzložni presežnik: the most + pridevnik; signal »in our class«.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: He drove ___ (carefully) than his brother.
postopek:
He drove more carefully (carefully) than his brother.

Prislov na -ly: more carefully.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Of all the runners, Ana ran ___ (fast).
postopek:
Of all the runners, Ana ran the fastest (fast).

fast je pridevnik in prislov: fast – faster – the fastest.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She speaks English very ___ (good).
postopek:
She speaks English very well (good).

Prislov od good je well.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The soup smells ___ (delicious).
postopek:
The soup smells delicious (delicious).

Za glagoli zaznavanja (smell, taste, look, sound) stoji pridevnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Please drive ___ (careful). The roads are icy.
postopek:
Please drive carefully (careful). The roads are icy.

Glagol drive opisuje prislov: careful → carefully.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: You look ___ (tired). Did you sleep at all?
postopek:
You look tired (tired). Did you sleep at all?

look = izgledati, sledi pridevnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He works very ___ (hard) – he's always the last to leave.
postopek:
He works very hard (hard) – he's always the last to leave.

hard je tudi prislov; hardly pomeni komaj.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I can ___ hear you. Can you speak up?
postopek:
I can hardly hear you. Can you speak up?

hardly = komaj.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Have you seen any good films ___?
postopek:
Have you seen any good films lately?

lately = v zadnjem času; late = pozno.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The team played ___ (bad) and lost 3:0.
postopek:
The team played badly (bad) and lost 3:0.

Prislov od bad je badly.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She smiled at me in a ___ (friend) way.
postopek:
She smiled at me in a friendly (friend) way.

friendly je pridevnik in nima prislova; uporabimo in a friendly way.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The situation changed ___ (dramatic) after the election.
postopek:
The situation changed dramatically (dramatic) after the election.

-ic → -ically.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I feel ___ (bad) about what I said.
postopek:
I feel bad (bad) about what I said.

feel kot občutek: sledi pridevnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She has a ___ (lovely) old wooden house.
postopek:
She has a lovely (lovely) old wooden house.

Mnenje (lovely) je prvo v vrsti pridevnikov.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He bought ___ jacket. (black, leather, old)
postopek:
He bought an old black leather jacket. (black, leather, old)

Vrstni red: starost – barva – snov (OSASCOMP).

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: They live in ___ house. (old, beautiful, big)
postopek:
They live in a beautiful big old house. (old, beautiful, big)

Vrstni red: mnenje – velikost – starost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She ___ for school. (late, never, is)
postopek:
She is never late for school. (late, never, is)

Prislov pogostnosti stoji za be: She is never late.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She speaks English very ___ (good).
postopek:
She speaks English very well (good).

Prislov od good je well.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The soup smells ___ (delicious).
postopek:
The soup smells delicious (delicious).

Za glagoli zaznavanja (smell, taste, look, sound) stoji pridevnik.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Please drive ___ (careful). The roads are icy.
postopek:
Please drive carefully (careful). The roads are icy.

Glagol drive opisuje prislov: careful → carefully.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: You look ___ (tired). Did you sleep at all?
postopek:
You look tired (tired). Did you sleep at all?

look = izgledati, sledi pridevnik.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: He works very ___ (hard) – he's always the last to leave.
postopek:
He works very hard (hard) – he's always the last to leave.

hard je tudi prislov; hardly pomeni komaj.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: I can ___ hear you. Can you speak up?
postopek:
I can hardly hear you. Can you speak up?

hardly = komaj.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Have you seen any good films ___?
postopek:
Have you seen any good films lately?

lately = v zadnjem času; late = pozno.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The team played ___ (bad) and lost 3:0.
postopek:
The team played badly (bad) and lost 3:0.

Prislov od bad je badly.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She smiled at me in a ___ (friend) way.
postopek:
She smiled at me in a friendly (friend) way.

friendly je pridevnik in nima prislova; uporabimo in a friendly way.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The situation changed ___ (dramatic) after the election.
postopek:
The situation changed dramatically (dramatic) after the election.

-ic → -ically.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: I feel ___ (bad) about what I said.
postopek:
I feel bad (bad) about what I said.

feel kot občutek: sledi pridevnik.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She has a ___ (lovely) old wooden house.
postopek:
She has a lovely (lovely) old wooden house.

Mnenje (lovely) je prvo v vrsti pridevnikov.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: He bought ___ jacket. (black, leather, old)
postopek:
He bought an old black leather jacket. (black, leather, old)

Vrstni red: starost – barva – snov (OSASCOMP).

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: They live in ___ house. (old, beautiful, big)
postopek:
They live in a beautiful big old house. (old, beautiful, big)

Vrstni red: mnenje – velikost – starost.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She ___ for school. (late, never, is)
postopek:
She is never late for school. (late, never, is)

Prislov pogostnosti stoji za be: She is never late.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The box is ___ heavy for me to carry.
postopek:
The box is too heavy for me to carry.

too + pridevnik + to = preveč, da bi.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She isn't old ___ to vote.
postopek:
She isn't old enough to vote.

pridevnik + enough.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: There were ___ many people that we couldn't get in.
postopek:
There were so many people that we couldn't get in.

so many + samostalnik + that.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: It was ___ a nice day that we went to the beach.
postopek:
It was such a nice day that we went to the beach.

such a + pridevnik + samostalnik + that.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: We haven't got ___ chairs for everyone.
postopek:
We haven't got enough chairs for everyone.

enough stoji pred samostalnikom.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The film was ___ boring that I fell asleep.
postopek:
The film was so boring that I fell asleep.

so + pridevnik + that.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: They are ___ nice people – you'll like them.
postopek:
They are such nice people – you'll like them.

such + pridevnik + množina (brez a).

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: There is ___ much sugar in this cake. I can't eat it.
postopek:
There is too much sugar in this cake. I can't eat it.

too much + neštevni samostalnik = preveč.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He didn't run fast ___ to catch the bus.
postopek:
He didn't run fast enough to catch the bus.

prislov + enough + to.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The lake is too cold ___ (swim) in.
postopek:
The lake is too cold to swim (swim) in.

too + pridevnik + to + glagol; predmeta (it) ne ponovimo.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The box is ___ heavy for me to carry.
postopek:
The box is too heavy for me to carry.

too + pridevnik + to = preveč, da bi.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: She isn't old ___ to vote.
postopek:
She isn't old enough to vote.

pridevnik + enough.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: There were ___ many people that we couldn't get in.
postopek:
There were so many people that we couldn't get in.

so many + samostalnik + that.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: It was ___ a nice day that we went to the beach.
postopek:
It was such a nice day that we went to the beach.

such a + pridevnik + samostalnik + that.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: We haven't got ___ chairs for everyone.
postopek:
We haven't got enough chairs for everyone.

enough stoji pred samostalnikom.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The film was ___ boring that I fell asleep.
postopek:
The film was so boring that I fell asleep.

so + pridevnik + that.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: They are ___ nice people – you'll like them.
postopek:
They are such nice people – you'll like them.

such + pridevnik + množina (brez a).

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: There is ___ much sugar in this cake. I can't eat it.
postopek:
There is too much sugar in this cake. I can't eat it.

too much + neštevni samostalnik = preveč.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: He didn't run fast ___ to catch the bus.
postopek:
He didn't run fast enough to catch the bus.

prislov + enough + to.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: The lake is too cold ___ (swim) in.
postopek:
The lake is too cold to swim (swim) in.

too + pridevnik + to + glagol; predmeta (it) ne ponovimo.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? I had never seen such a beautiful place. (Never …)
postopek:
Never had I seen such a beautiful place.

Never + had + osebek + 3. oblika.
moznosti: Never I had seen such a beautiful place.
Never have I see such a beautiful place.
Never did I had seen such a beautiful place.
Never had I seen such a beautiful place.
rezultat: D   Never had I seen such a beautiful place.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? It saves money and it also protects nature. (Not only …)
postopek:
Not only does it save money, but it also protects nature.

Not only + does + osebek + osnovna oblika.
moznosti: Not only does it save money, but it also protects nature.
Not only it does save money, but protects nature.
Not only saves it money, but also it protects nature.
Not only it saves money, but it also protects nature.
rezultat: A   Not only does it save money, but it also protects nature.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? The noise annoyed me most. (What …)
postopek:
What annoyed me most was the noise.

What + stavek + was + poudarjeni del.
moznosti: What the noise annoyed me most.
What annoyed me most was the noise.
That annoyed me most was the noise.
What annoyed me most it was the noise.
rezultat: B   What annoyed me most was the noise.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? Ana called, not Maja. (It was …)
postopek:
It was Ana who called.

It was + oseba + who.
moznosti: It was Ana which she called.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? After she had read the letter, she cried. (Having …)
postopek:
Having read the letter, she cried.

Having + 3. oblika za prej končano dejanje.
moznosti: Having read the letter, she cried.
Having been read the letter, she cried.
Having reading the letter, she cried.
Having she read the letter, she cried.
rezultat: A   Having read the letter, she cried.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? Because he felt tired, he went to bed. (Feeling …)
postopek:
Feeling tired, he went to bed.

-ing za vzrok, isti osebek.
moznosti: Feeling tired, he goes to bed yesterday.
Feeling tired, the bed was ready.
Feeling tired, he went to bed.
Felt tired, he went to bed.
rezultat: C   Feeling tired, he went to bed.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? We sat down and immediately the phone rang. (No sooner …)
postopek:
No sooner had we sat down than the phone rang.

No sooner had … than.
moznosti: No sooner we had sat down than the phone rang.
No sooner did we sat down than the phone rang.
No sooner had we sat down when the phone rang.
No sooner had we sat down than the phone rang.
rezultat: D   No sooner had we sat down than the phone rang.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? You should not open the door in any situation. (Under no circumstances …)
postopek:
Under no circumstances should you open the door.

Under no circumstances + should + osebek.
moznosti: Under no circumstances should you open the door.
Under no circumstances should you not open the door.
Under no circumstances do you should open the door.
Under no circumstances you should open the door.
rezultat: A   Under no circumstances should you open the door.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? I appreciated my parents only when I left home. (Only when …)
postopek:
Only when I left home did I appreciate my parents.

Inverzija v glavnem stavku: did I appreciate.
moznosti: Only when did I leave home I appreciated my parents.
Only when I left home did I appreciate my parents.
Only when I left home I did appreciate my parents.
Only when I left home I appreciated my parents.
rezultat: B   Only when I left home did I appreciate my parents.

besedilo: Katera poved pomeni isto in se začne z danimi besedami? People believe that she is the best. (She is …)
postopek:
She is believed to be the best.

Brezosebni trpnik: be believed to + nedoločnik.
moznosti: She believed to be the best.
She is believed to be the best.
She is believed that she is the best.
She is believing to be the best.
rezultat: B   She is believed to be the best.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Water ___ (boil) at 100 degrees.
postopek:
Water boils (boil) at 100 degrees.

Dejstvo: present simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Look! The baby ___ (sleep).
postopek:
Look! The baby is sleeping (sleep).

Zdaj: present continuous.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I ___ (not know) the answer.
postopek:
I don't know (not know) the answer.

know je glagol stanja.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: We ___ (live) here since 2015.
postopek:
We have lived (live) here since 2015.

since + present perfect.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: When we got to the cinema, the film ___ (already start).
postopek:
When we got to the cinema, the film had already started (already start).

Prej v preteklosti: past perfect.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: This time next week we ___ (lie) on the beach.
postopek:
This time next week we will be lying (lie) on the beach.

Future continuous: dejanje v teku ob času v prihodnosti.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: By 2030 they ___ (finish) the new motorway.
postopek:
By 2030 they will have finished (finish) the new motorway.

By + čas v prihodnosti: future perfect.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: When I was a child, I ___ climb trees every day.
postopek:
When I was a child, I used to climb trees every day.

Pretekla navada: used to / would.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She isn't used to ___ (drive) on the left.
postopek:
She isn't used to driving (drive) on the left.

be used to + -ing.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If I ___ (be) you, I would apologise.
postopek:
If I were (be) you, I would apologise.

Drugi pogojnik: If I were you.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: If they had left earlier, they ___ (not miss) the train.
postopek:
If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed (not miss) the train.

Tretji pogojnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: We'll go for a walk unless it ___ (rain).
postopek:
We'll go for a walk unless it rains (rain).

unless = if not + present.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I wish I ___ (have) more free time.
postopek:
I wish I had (have) more free time.

wish + past za sedanjost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The museum ___ (visit) by thousands of tourists every year.
postopek:
The museum is visited (visit) by thousands of tourists every year.

Trpnik, present simple.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The new school ___ (build) at the moment.
postopek:
The new school is being built (build) at the moment.

Trpnik, present continuous.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I need to have my car ___ (repair).
postopek:
I need to have my car repaired (repair).

have something done.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She said she ___ (be) tired.
postopek:
She said she was (be) tired.

Poročani govor: premik časa.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He asked me where I ___ (live).
postopek:
He asked me where I lived (live).

Poročano vprašanje: brez inverzije.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: You ___ wear a uniform; it's optional.
postopek:
You don't have to wear a uniform; it's optional.

don't have to = ni treba.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: He ___ be at home: the lights are on.
postopek:
He must be at home: the lights are on.

Prepričano sklepanje: must.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I can't find my keys. I ___ left them at school.
postopek:
I can't find my keys. I might have left them at school.

Ugibanje o preteklosti: might have + 3. oblika.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I'll never forget ___ (meet) you for the first time.
postopek:
I'll never forget meeting (meet) you for the first time.

forget + -ing = spomin na preteklost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: They let us ___ (leave) early.
postopek:
They let us leave (leave) early.

let + nedoločnik brez to.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: ___ Netherlands is famous for its tulips.
postopek:
The Netherlands is famous for its tulips.

Ime države v množini: the.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: There were only ___ people at the party, so it was boring.
postopek:
There were only a few people at the party, so it was boring.

a few + števni samostalnik; tu tudi few, a s poudarkom na malo.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: This is ___ interesting book I've ever read.
postopek:
This is the most interesting book I've ever read.

Presežnik: the most.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The ___ you practise, the better you get.
postopek:
The more you practise, the better you get.

the + primernik …, the + primernik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: She sings ___.
postopek:
She sings well.

Prislov od good: well.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: It was ___ a good film that we watched it twice.
postopek:
It was such a good film that we watched it twice.

such a + pridevnik + samostalnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: You live near here, ___?
postopek:
You live near here, don't you?

Trdilna poved → nikalni dodatek.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: Could you tell me where the station ___?
postopek:
Could you tell me where the station is?

Posredno vprašanje: osebek pred glagolom.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The girl ___ bike was stolen called the police.
postopek:
The girl whose bike was stolen called the police.

whose = čigar.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: I'll text you as soon as I ___ (arrive).
postopek:
I'll text you as soon as I arrive (arrive).

as soon as + present za prihodnost.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: ___ the bad weather, the match went ahead.
postopek:
Despite the bad weather, the match went ahead.

Despite + samostalnik.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: It depends ___ the weather.
postopek:
It depends on the weather.

depend on.

besedilo: Izberi pravilno možnost: The film was very ___ (disappoint).
postopek:
The film was very disappointing (disappoint).

-ing pridevnik opisuje stvar.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Water ___ (boil) at 100 degrees.
postopek:
Water boils (boil) at 100 degrees.

Dejstvo: present simple.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: Look! The baby ___ (sleep).
postopek:
Look! The baby is sleeping (sleep).

Zdaj: present continuous.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: I ___ (not know) the answer.
postopek:
I don't know (not know) the answer.

know je glagol stanja.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: We ___ (live) here since 2015.
postopek:
We have lived (live) here since 2015.

since + present perfect.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: When we got to the cinema, the film ___ (already start).
postopek:
When we got to the cinema, the film had already started (already start).

Prej v preteklosti: past perfect.

besedilo: Vpiši manjkajoči del: This time next week we ___ (lie) on the beach.

besedilo: V formalni pritožbi moraš zahtevati vračilo denarja. Kateri stavek je najprimernejši?
postopek: Formalni register: pogojnik (would be grateful if you could), povezovalec therefore in ustaljena fraza at your earliest convenience.
moznosti: Give me my money back now.
I would therefore be grateful if you could refund the full amount at your earliest convenience.
So, can you send the cash back or what?
rezultat: C   I would therefore be grateful if you could refund the full amount at your earliest convenience.

besedilo: Kateri zaključek je pravilen za formalno pismo, ki se začne z Dear Sir or Madam,?
postopek: Če naslovnika ne poznamo po imenu (Dear Sir or Madam), v britanski angleščini končamo z Yours faithfully; če ga (Dear Mr Smith), z Yours sincerely.

besedilo: Govorec v posnetku reče: “I wouldn't say the lecture was a waste of time, but I could have spent the afternoon more wisely.” Kaj meni o predavanju?
postopek: Litota I wouldn't say … a waste of time omili kritiko, could have spent … more wisely pa pove, da ni bilo vredno časa.
moznosti: Ni bilo povsem brez koristi, a ni bilo vredno njegovega časa.
Bilo je odlično in zelo koristno.
rezultat: A   Ni bilo povsem brez koristi, a ni bilo vredno njegovega časa.

besedilo: “The train due to arrive at platform four at 9:15 is now expected at 9:40. We apologise for the delay.” Koliko minut zamude ima vlak?
postopek: due to arrive at 9:15 = po voznem redu ob 9.15; now expected at 9:40 = zdaj pričakovan ob 9.40. Razlika je 25 minut.

besedilo: “Had I known the tickets would sell out so quickly, I'd have booked them the moment they went on sale.” Kaj se je zgodilo?
postopek: Tretji pogojnik z inverzijo (Had I known …, I'd have booked) opisuje neuresničeno preteklo možnost: ni vedel in ni kupil.
moznosti: Vstopnice je kupil takoj, ko so bile na voljo.
Vstopnic ni kupil pravočasno in so jih razprodali.
rezultat: C   Vstopnic ni kupil pravočasno in so jih razprodali.

besedilo: “It's not that I don't trust him; it's just that he's let us down before.” Kakšen je govorčev odnos?
postopek: let somebody down = razočarati, pustiti na cedilu. Stavek omili nezaupanje, a ga ne zanika.
moznosti: Previden je, ker ga je ta oseba že razočarala.
rezultat: A   Previden je, ker ga je ta oseba že razočarala.

besedilo: “Prices went up by ten percent in January and then fell by ten percent in June.” Kakšna je cena junija v primerjavi z začetno?
postopek: 1,10 · 0,90 = 0,99, torej 1 % nižja od začetne cene.

besedilo: “You needn't have brought an umbrella; the forecast says it'll be sunny all day.” Kaj pomeni stavek?
postopek: needn't have + deležnik pomeni, da je nekdo nekaj naredil po nepotrebnem. didn't need to bi le povedal, da ni bilo treba.
moznosti: Dežnik je prinesel, a ga ni bilo treba.
Dežnika ni prinesel, ker ga ni potreboval.
rezultat: B   Dežnik je prinesel, a ga ni bilo treba.

besedilo: “I'd rather you didn't mention this to anyone until it's official.” Kaj govorec želi?
postopek: I'd rather you + preteklik izraža vljudno željo o vedenju drugega: raje bi videl, da ne poveš.
moznosti: Naj sogovornik zaenkrat nikomur ne pove.
rezultat: C   Naj sogovornik zaenkrat nikomur ne pove.

besedilo: “The museum is open daily except Mondays, but on public holidays it closes two hours early, at 4 p.m.” Kdaj se muzej običajno zapre?
postopek: Na praznike se zapre dve uri prej, ob 16.00, torej je običajni čas zapiranja 18.00. Ob ponedeljkih je zaprt.

besedilo: Pri ustnem izpitu želiš pridobiti čas za razmislek. Katera fraza je najprimernejša?
postopek: Fraza pohvali vprašanje in vljudno pridobi čas, ne da bi pogovor obstal.
moznosti: That's an interesting question. Let me think about it for a moment.
rezultat: D   That's an interesting question. Let me think about it for a moment.

besedilo: Pri opisu slike moraš izraziti domnevo. Kateri stavek je pravilen?
postopek: Logični sklep o preteklosti: must have + deležnik (tu trajni: must have been waiting).
moznosti: The man must have been waiting for a long time; he looks exhausted.
The man must waited for a long time; he looks exhausted.
The man can have been waiting for a long time; he looks exhausted.
The man should have waited since a long time; he looks exhausted.
rezultat: A   The man must have been waiting for a long time; he looks exhausted.
